effect.purpose: Read-only Effect v4 source pinned to the tag matching the installed effect (the lockfile's resolution of the pnpm-plugin-effect catalog) — the authority on what v4 actually exports, plus the v3→v4 migration notes and the @effect/vitest reference implementation. Re-pin whenever the lockfile's effect version moves.

orientation.layout: Sparse checkout: packages/effect (core source + package.json exports map), packages/vitest (@effect/vitest reference implementation), migration/ (per-domain v3→v4 notes).
orientation.startHere: packages/effect/src settles what v4 actually exports; migration/*.md settles v3→v4 renames. Before trusting an answer, check the pin matches the installed effect version (node -p "require('effect/package.json').version" from packages/engine) — node_modules wins on disagreement.
